messages:
incident-bot: [P1] SmartRouting alert at 2003456789 - high error rate (502/compatibility) and repeated cross-region fallbacks for requests requiring tool_call. Percentage of requests bouncing between eu-west-1 <> us-west-2: ~18% over last 3m. Auto-escalating to #incidents and paging oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall-amy: I'm on pager, investigating. First glance: routing policy is flipping between model-variant 'gptx-16k-quant' and 'gptx-16k-fp16' depending on capacity. Tool-call requests hit quant variant which errors out and triggers region fallback -> then fallback route prefers quantized in other region -> loop.

infra-leo: can you grab the routing decision traces? `sbroutes` traces should show policy evals.

sre-bot: attaching trace sample (redacted):
```
trace_id: t-8f4c9
route_eval: {
  request: { tool_call: true, context_len: 12000 }
  model_group: gptx-16k
  preferred_variant_order: [quant, fp16]
  selected_variant: quant
  variant_error: "tool_call not_supported"
  fallback: region-eu-west-1 -> region-us-west-2
  fallback_selected_variant: quant
  loop_detected: true
}
error_samples: 502, 503
```

eng-runtime-sam: confirmed - quantized variant currently has tool_call disabled in the availability matrix but the routing policy still treats quant as viable for tool_call requests because of an older compatibility flag. Likely a stale flag flip during last week's rollout.

ml-q-marta: we shipped a micro-optimization that marks quant variant as preferred for latency; we did NOT enable tool_call support for it. Looks like the compatibility matrix entry for variant capabilities wasn't updated when the rollout flipped preference order. My bad.

oncall-amy: mitigation plan (short):
1) Temporarily disable cross-region fallback for requests with tool_call for model_group gptx-16k.
2) Patch routing policy to prefer fp16 for requests where tool_call=true.
3) Notify customers and start postmortem.

eng-runtime-sam: to apply quick policy change - POST to control plane with tiny patch. Example (doing now):
```
PATCH /v1/control/routing/policy/gptx-16k
payload:
  allow_region_fallback_for_tool_calls: false
  preference_overrides:
    when: { tool_call: true }
    prefer: [ fp16, quant ]
```

prod-ops: @oncall-amy - pls run the patch and report back. I can hold the rollback step ready.

oncall-amy: applying patch now. Curl run: `curl -X PATCH -k 'https://controlplane.internal/policy/gptx-16k' -d 'allow_region_fallback_for_tool_calls=false'` -> 200 OK.

oncall-amy: verifying routing decisions after patch...

sre-bot: deploy-bot logs: policy-patch 2003456798 applied by oncall-amy, change_id ch-9921. Canary started (10% traffic).

infra-leo: monitoring traces... canary looks good, loop rate dropped from 18% to 0.6% in the canary cohort. No new 502s in canary.

customer-success-jai: quick customer impact check - I'm pulling list of customers who had errors in last 15m. Early list: AcmeHealth, SimpliDocs, NovaChat. Reaching out to support to open tickets.

eng-runtime-sam: temporary mitigation validated. Next steps:
- ML to update the compatibility matrix to mark "quantized" variant tool_call=false (source of truth).
- Runtime to add explicit gating in SmartRouting: never fallback to variant that lacks required capabilities.
- Add unit test to detect routing preference/compat mismatch.

ml-q-marta: creating matrix PR now. Will include reason: quantized variant doesn't support tool_call (kv cache + tooling ABI mismatch). PR: update/variants/gptx-16k.yml -> set tool_call: false, max_context: 16384.

prod-ops: @marta please also add note about context length - we saw requests with 18k tokens failing across variants. That should be capped at 16k and trigger explicit reject rather than fallback.

ml-q-marta: will add. PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/variants/pulls/314 (draft).

oncall-amy: rolling patch to all regions to disable region fallback for tool_call requests. Applying now (scripting). ETA ~6m.

sre-bot: automation report: global policy patch applied to 6 regions at 2003457002, change ch-9921. No rollout errors.

eng-runtime-sam: while patch is in place, we should also push a small hotfix to routing evaluator to stop oscillating if a variant returns capability_mismatch (treat as terminal for that request). I'll open a PR and coordinate with infra for a 10-min canary.

prod-ops: customer-impact update: 3 customers impacted, 12 total failed requests logged as tool_call errors (most were retries that kept hitting quant variant). We should offer credit + incident notice.

customer-success-jai: drafting message to customers now. Short note: "We observed degraded responses for API calls using tool-based features; mitigation applied; we are evaluating root cause and next steps." Will send after we confirm full rollout.

deploy-bot: canary check passed at 2003457140. Global rollout at 2003457205.

oncall-amy: verification - sim tests for tool_call flows passing across eu/us regions. Also ran synthetic for long-context (>16k) -> now rejects with a clear 400 and message: 'context_length_exceeded'.

ml-q-marta: matrix PR merged and propagated to control-plane metadata at 2003457333. Variant record for gptx-16k-quant now: tool_call=false, max_context=16384, supports_streaming=true.

eng-runtime-sam: added a quick check into SmartRouting: if variant_capabilities[variant].required_feature is false -> mark variant_ineligible_for_request. Unit tests added. PR 1102 queued for CI.

prod-ops: assigning follow-ups:
- marta: postmortem owner + fix compatibility docs (ETA 24h)
- sam: runtime gating + unit tests (ETA 48h)
- leo: add CI guard to flag preference/compat mismatches (ETA 72h)
- amy: update runbook to include 'disable cross-region fallback for capability-mismatches' step.

customer-success-jai: sent notifications to impacted customers at 2003457550. Responses: AcmeHealth asked for timeline; assigned AM to follow up.

oncall-amy: incident status -> mitigated, no ongoing customer-visible errors after global patch. Keeping thread open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: recording incident in incident tracker: INC-2026-0315-007.

eng-runtime-sam: minor note for follow-up: audit the rollout that changed variant preference - that change should have updated compatibility matrix too. Likely process gap.

ml-q-marta: adding that to postmortem. Also will add a pre-merge CI check to block preference flips that don't have explicit capability mapping.

prod-ops: thanks team. Closing active pager. Will reopen if symptoms recur.

oncall-amy: I will prepare a short incident summary for leadership and link the postmortem when ready.

sre-bot: incident closed for pager rotation at 2003460400.
